draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Following up on my note last week — no response needed, I just want to make the first step easy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one project is usually the thing that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything that's unclear.

Best,
Nadia
